faq.q: What is the origin of Mabrouk?
faq.a: Mabrouk is associated with Arabic. Mabrouk is Arabic مُبَارَك (Mubārak) 'blessed, fortunate', from the root ب ر ك (b-r-k). The source gloss 'Fortunate, blessed' is consistent. Same name as mabruk.
Yes — the underlying form مبارك is Arabic.

faq.a: Romanization variants include Mabrouk, mabrouk. Script forms are مبارك, مبارک, मुबारक.

faq.q: Is Mabrouk a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records this form as male. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
